item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 04:00 PM 16 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Bukidnon(Cabanglasan, Maramag, Quezon, Baungon, Talakag), #ZamboangaDelNorte(SergioOsmeñaSr., Siayan, Godod, Sindangan, LeonB.Postigo, Tampilisan, Salug), #ZamboangaDelSur(Midsalip, Sominot, RamonMagsaysay, Tambulig, Aurora, Tukuran, Labangan, PagadianCity, Bayog, Lakewood), #MisamisOccidental(DonVictorianoChiongbian, Bonifacio), #LanaoDelNorte(Nunungan, SultanNagaDimaporo, Sapad, Kapatagan), #LanaoDelSur(Picong), #ZamboangaSibugay(Naga and Kabasalan) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Bukidnon(CityOfMalaybalay, CityOfValencia, Lantapan), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dumingag, Mahayag, Molave and Josefina) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
